rules.quote: After each implementation phase, run a parallel team of reviewers and iterate fixes until all reviewers return PASS before moving to the next phase.
rules.rule: After each implementation phase, run a parallel team of reviewers and iterate fixes until all reviewers return PASS before moving to the next phase.

rules.quote: spawn reviewers in parallel: security, docs alignment, plan alignment, code best practices (Opus model), architecture, observability.
rules.rule: After each phase, spawn the reviewers in parallel: security, docs alignment, plan alignment, code best practices (using the Opus model), architecture, and observability.

rules.quote: If any reviewer returns FAIL, spawn a fix agent, then re-run all reviewers.
rules.rule: If any reviewer returns FAIL, spawn a fix agent, then re-run all reviewers.

rules.quote: Only proceed to the next phase when every reviewer returns PASS.
rules.rule: Only proceed to the next phase when every reviewer returns PASS.

rules.quote: LOW findings are non-blocking; HIGH and MEDIUM block the phase.
rules.rule: Treat LOW review findings as non-blocking, and treat HIGH and MEDIUM review findings as blocking the phase.

rules.quote: write them to `.claude/skills/` inside the project repo and commit them alongside the code they support.
rules.rule: When adding or updating Claude Code skills, write them to `.claude/skills/` inside the project repo and commit them alongside the code they support.

rules.quote: also copy it to `/Users/guedes/Code/planner-frontend/.claude/skills/` and include it in the next commit.
rules.rule: After writing a skill to the global `~/.claude/skills/`, also copy it to `/Users/guedes/Code/planner-frontend/.claude/skills/` and include it in the next commit.

rules.quote: Add an **Observability** reviewer to every post-implementation review team
rules.rule: Include an Observability reviewer in every post-implementation review team, alongside the security, docs, plan alignment, code best practices, and architecture reviewers.

rules.quote: Spawn a 6th reviewer agent (parallel with the others) after each implementation phase.
rules.rule: After each implementation phase, spawn a sixth Observability reviewer agent to run in parallel with the other reviewers.

rules.quote: check whether the implemented code has adequate logging/tracing for debug purposes
rules.rule: When reviewing implemented code, check whether it has adequate logging and tracing for debugging purposes.

rules.quote: PASS if coverage is adequate or the code is simple enough that logging adds no value.
rules.rule: Give the Observability review a PASS when logging coverage is adequate or the code is simple enough that logging adds no value.

rules.quote: FAIL if errors are silently swallowed or there are complex async paths with no observability.
rules.rule: Give the Observability review a FAIL if errors are silently swallowed or if complex async paths have no observability.

rules.quote: Always use the Write or Edit tools when creating or modifying files.
rules.rule: When creating or modifying files, use the Write or Edit tools.

rules.quote: Never use `cat <<EOF >` or `echo >` redirects in Bash.
rules.rule: Never use `cat <<EOF >` or `echo >` redirects in Bash to create or modify files.

rules.quote: Any time a file needs to be created or edited, reach for Write/Edit first.
rules.rule: Whenever a file needs to be created or edited, try the Write or Edit tool first.

rules.quote: Only use Bash for commands that can't be done with dedicated tools (running builds, git operations, etc.).
rules.rule: Use Bash only for commands that cannot be done with dedicated tools, such as running builds or git operations.

rules.quote: Iterate until all PASS before moving to next phase.
rules.rule: Iterate the review loop until all six reviewers pass before moving to the next phase.

rules.quote: Plant colors derived from PlantType.category (no color field in schema)
rules.rule: Derive plant colors from PlantType.category; do not look for or use a color field on the plant schema.

rules.quote: handlers on `<Rect fill="rgba(0,0,0,0.001)">` (not Layer)
rules.rule: Attach terrain pointer handlers to a `<Rect fill="rgba(0,0,0,0.001)">` element, not to the Layer.

rules.quote: pushHistory pattern: `structuredClone(proj)` BEFORE updateProject, push AFTER
rules.rule: When recording history, call structuredClone(proj) before updateProject and push the history entry after it.

rules.quote: OverflowDimLayer at slot 10 (above all content)
rules.rule: Place OverflowDimLayer at slot 10, above all other content, rather than at the conceptual slot 2 from the spec.

rules.quote: Boundary committed edges: dashed `dash={[6/zoom, 4/zoom]}`
rules.rule: Render committed boundary edges with the dash pattern dash={[6/zoom, 4/zoom]}.

rules.quote: stage.getRelativePointerPosition() = world coords directly (Stage has scaleX/scaleY for zoom)
rules.rule: Use stage.getRelativePointerPosition() as world coordinates directly without additional zoom conversion, since the Stage carries scaleX/scaleY for zoom.
